meta.title: For tuition institutes
meta.description: ReMix for institutes with many teachers and hundreds of students. Owner, teacher, cashier and gatekeeper roles, a bank slip queue, cash counter, halls and timetable, and reports for your accountant.

hero.title: Every teacher, hall and cashier on one system.
hero.subtitle: For institutes with many teachers and hundreds of students. Each person sees only what their job needs, and you see all of it.

owner.title: Owner
owner.body: Income by class and month, unpaid students, attendance trends, staff and settings.

teacher.title: Teacher
teacher.body: Their own classes, lessons and Zoom sessions. No access to other teachers' income.

cashier.title: Cashier
cashier.body: Cash counter and bank slip queue. Search a student, pick the month, print the receipt.

gatekeeper.title: Gatekeeper
gatekeeper.body: The ReMix+ gate app only. Scan, see paid or unpaid, let them in.

rush.title: Built for the Saturday rush at the counter.

slips.title: Bank slip queue
slips.body: Slip image beside the expected amount. Approve with A, reject with R, next slip loads by itself.

cash.title: Cash counter mode
cash.body: Three cashiers at once, each with their own login and end-of-day total.

halls.title: Halls and timetable
halls.body: Hall A, Hall B and Zoom in one weekly view. Expected versus present for every class.

reports.title: Reports you can hand over
reports.body: Income by class and teacher, exported to CSV or PDF for your accountant.

separate.title: Kept separate.
separate.body: No other institute can see your students or income.

support.title: Recorded support.
support.body: If Recca staff open your account, it's logged with a reason and you see a banner.

audit.title: Audit log.
audit.body: See who approved which payment and who changed which fee.

backups.title: Nightly backups.
backups.body: Export everything to CSV whenever you want.

plan.label: Example monthly price for an institute with {students, number} students
plan.assumption: Assumes {classes} classes per student at {perCard} per class card.
plan.enterprise: Branches or {max, number}+ students? See Enterprise

demo.title: Book a demo
demo.body: A 30-minute call, at your institute or on Zoom. We'll show ReMix with your own classes and fees.

points.call: A 30-minute call with the ReMix team
points.place: At your institute or on Zoom, whichever suits you
points.own: We show ReMix with your own classes and fees

demo.note: We reply on WhatsApp, usually within two working hours.
